meridian_empty_summary: No workflows or sandbox builds recorded yet. Send a proposed app from HeavyRain to start a build.
meridian_failed_detail: The builder stopped before producing a runnable app. Check the progress log for the recorded error.
conflict: Live build {run_id} is already running for this organization. Wait for it to finish or cancel it before starting another build.
unknown_run: Live build run not found. Check the run ID or request the current build for this organization.
actor_mismatch: This requester ID is not permitted for this organization. Use an authorized persona ID for this tenant and try again.
provider_missing_id: The builder service returned a response without an interaction ID. Retry the build request.
provider_missing_environment: The builder completed the run without returning an environment ID, so workspace files could not be downloaded.
download_failed: Could not download or extract the workspace archive from the builder environment.
poll_failed_title: Stopped polling after repeated status check errors
request_detail: Queued live sandbox build for {app_name}, requested by {requester}.
unsupported_org: Live sandbox builds are not supported for organization '{org_id}'. Submit live build requests to 'meridian'.
template_invalid: Live builder prompt template is missing required placeholders: {placeholders}.
